title: How Long After a BBL Can I Sit? Week by Week, With a Pillow
meta_description: Not on your buttocks for at least 2 weeks, then briefly on a pillow until about week 8. What to do at work, in the car and at home.
excerpt: Cleveland Clinic says not to sit on your buttocks for at least 2 weeks, and most people need a BBL pillow for about 8 weeks. Here is the timeline, how to use the pillow, what to do at a desk, in a car and on the toilet, and what to do if you sat by accident.
quick_answer:
How long after a BBL can I sit?

Cleveland Clinic says not on your buttocks for at least 2 weeks. A surgeon interviewed by ASPS allows about 10 minutes at a time for the first six weeks. Most people use a pillow for about 8 weeks. Your surgeon clears you.
